jobs.title: Business Analyst - Digital Commercial Analytics
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

At H\&M, we are committed to creating meaningful growth through customer\-centric and data\-informed decision making. We are now looking for a Business Analyst to join the Digital Commercial Analytics team.


In this role, you will combine commercial understanding, analytical expertise and stakeholder collaboration to identify opportunities, evaluate business performance and support sustainable growth across our digital business. You will work closely with QCP (Quantified Commercial Plan), Marketing, Digital, Controlling and Sales Markets to translate data into insights and recommendations that strengthen commercial decision\-making and execution.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Analyse digital and commercial performance to identify opportunities, risks and growth drivers.
* Turn strategic business questions into actionable insights and recommendations through customer, sales and behavioural analysis.
* Develop business cases and support prioritisation of initiatives and investments.
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses to understand customer behaviour and the drivers behind business performance.
* Partner with QCP to develop, maintain and evolve frameworks, tools, guidelines and best practices.
* Drive best practices, analytical frameworks and capability development for Commercial Business Analysts across Sales Markets, enabling more consistent and impactful commercial decision\-making.
* Provide analytical support and insights related to post\-purchase customer experience, fulfilment, returns and customer behaviour.
* Support business reviews, hindsight analyses and strategic planning through fact\-based recommendations.
* Contribute to the continuous development of analytical methods, tools, technologies and ways of working within the team.

**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**


You will be part of the Digital Commercial Analytics team within the Digital Unit in the Commercial function, working closely with global and local commercial stakeholders, analysts, data teams and digital functions. The team’s mission is to drive digital business performance through advanced analytics, strategic insights, and business cases that enable better decision\-making across H\&M’s global online business.


The role reports to the Digital Commercial Manager.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We believe you are a highly analytical and commercially minded person who enjoys solving complex business challenges through data and insights. You can connect customer behaviour, digital performance and commercial outcomes, translating findings into recommendations that create business impact.


You are comfortable working across functions, influencing stakeholders through a fact\-based approach and communicating complex topics in a clear and engaging way.

*We are looking for people with:*

* 5\+ years of experience within business analysis, commercial analytics, business controlling, commercial planning or a similar field.
* Strong understanding of digital business, e\-commerce and customer behaviour
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with complex datasets.
* Strong understanding of commercial performance drivers, customer behaviour and digital business KPIs.
* Proven ability to develop business cases and translate insights into recommendations and actions.
* Experience using AI\-enabled tools, automation and modern analytical capabilities to enhance analysis, improve ways of working and strengthen decision\-making.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with analytical tools and platforms such as Power BI, Excel, BigQuery and other data analysis tools.
* A collaborative mindset and a passion for driving business impact through insights.

**Additional Information**


This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden.  

 If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English before 1st of October**.**


Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation


At H\&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse \& Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age.


Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward\-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building.


Our Offer


At H\&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value\-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future.

 **Additional Information** **WHO WE ARE**


H\&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.


**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


We offer all our employees at H\&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H\&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories,

jobs.title: Business Analyst, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
*How will AI transform the way organizations work? At KPMG NewTech, you won't just discuss that question, you'll help answer it. Working with some of Denmark's largest organizations, you will help design AI\-native ways of working through our NewPractice methodology, implement AI solutions, and support adoption across the business. If you are interested in emerging technologies, steep learning curves, and the opportunity to shape the future of work, this is the place to do it.*

  


**About the role**


As a consultant in NewTech, you will help deliver AI transformation projects from strategy to implementation and adoption. You will support clients in rethinking how work gets done through AI, combining technology, change management, and business value creation.


Using our NewPractice methodology, you will help organizations build AI\-native ways of working, working closely with clients, supporting project delivery, and contributing to proposals and new ideas. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys learning, and is motivated by ownership and impact.


AI is at the core of how we work. You will actively use AI tools in your daily work, helping us deliver projects smarter, develop new methods faster, and demonstrate effective AI adoption in practice.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


* Contribute to AI transformation projects end\-to\-end: scoping, delivery, and adoption.
* Work directly with client teams to design AI\-native processes using our NewPractice methodology.
* Use AI tools regularly in your own work and helping clients and colleagues do the same.
* Translate what our technical teams build into something clients understand and want to use.
* Support proposals and helping prioritize use cases based on value, feasibility and impact.
* Help develop our methods and delivery approach as we scale.

**Perks of joining NewTech**


At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. Unlike traditional consultants, we not only advise clients on transformation but also help design, build, and implement solutions alongside them. Our projects combine AI, automation, emerging technologies, and organizational change, giving you the opportunity to work across business and technical disciplines while turning ideas into practical solutions.


Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists, and software developers who collaborate closely and learn from one another. Working in cross\-functional teams, you will develop both advisory and technology\-related skills while gaining experience from colleagues with diverse backgrounds.


What sets NewTech apart is our focus on consulting. From day one, you will help shape solutions, test technologies, and work directly with clients to promote adoption and value realization. It is an ideal environment for those who want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges.

  


**About you, our new team member**


You have good analytical skills and enjoy solving business challenges where technology plays a central role. You are motivated by analyzing processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and turning complex problems into actionable solutions. Experience with process mapping, use case development, value assessment, and stakeholder management is an advantage.


You are curious about how AI, automation, and data create business value and are motivated to learn about both the organizational and technical sides of transformation. Most importantly, you are self\-motivated, collaborative, and motivated to grow in a fast\-evolving field.


 More specifically, we are looking for someone who:


* Has some background in AI, automation, or digital transformation, whether within strategy, delivery, or change.
* Has experience using AI tools in your work or studies, with an interest in developing your AI skills.
* Has a structured way of working and the ability to keep projects moving forward.
* Is comfortable working in an evolving environment where not everything is defined in advance.
* Has a genuine curiosity about AI, its impact on organizations, and emerging trends shaping the business landscape.
* Is fluent in English and Danish or another Scandinavian language.
* Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027\.

**KPMG Advisory Academy**


As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14\-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.


Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

  


**Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!**


The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier \- so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.


All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one\-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you \- your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.


The questions are:


* Describe a project where you solved a challenging problem using data, analytics, automation, or AI. What was the problem, how did you approach it, what did you implement, and what did you learn?
* Imagine you need to explain the value of using AI‑enabled ways of working with a client who has never used AI before. How would you approach the conversation and help them understand how AI could support t

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Business Analyst \- Student Assistant
  

  

Please remember to attach your CV, cover letter and latest grade transcripts in your application.
  

  

As part of the strategy team for a company of over 100,000 people, operating in 130 countries, MMC is at the forefront of creating high\-impact strategies to generate growth and drive transformation in one of the world’s largest integrated logistics companies.
  

  

We are a team of bright colleagues working in an international environment based at Maersk HQ in the center of Copenhagen, Denmark, and have delivered projects across the globe since our founding in 2012\.
  

  

We offer a top\-tier consulting experience in a collaborative and hypothesis\-driven environment while building a strong platform for a future career at Maersk.
**How will you shape the future of A.P. Moller\-Maersk?**

As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate in project teams of 3\-5 consultants. You will work 20 hours a week with high flexibility around exam periods. The position offers exposure to stakeholders across Maersk, focusing on driving growth and defining future strategies. We will support you as you learn and grow by developing the following qualifications:  



  

* Understanding and addressing business problems in a structured and logical manner while developing sustainable and practical solutions
* Developing logical reasoning and data modelling for analysis
Communicating insights and results to senior decision\-makers  
* 

  

**Who are you?**

Whether you are a third\-year Bachelor’s student or Master’s student in business, engineering or economics – or maybe something entirely different – we would love to hear from you!


Irrespective of your line of study we are looking for students willing to develop the tools required to become a Consultant. We will be looking for the below in our assessment of your profile:  



  

* Record of strong academic performance
* Curiosity and excitement to learn new things
* Propensity for building strong, professional relationships and thriving in a dynamic environment
* Inclusive and creative mindset
Strong sense of ownership of tasks  
* 

  

**Shape the future with us**

**To be eligible for the Student Assistant position, you must be currently enrolled at a Danish university** Applications will be reviewed in the order of submission. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until our positions are filled, so we urge you to submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 18 October 2026\.  



  

Please upload all required documents \- **CV, cover letter, and grade transcripts** \- under the **“Resume/CV”** field. This is the **only place in the application where documents can be uploaded** . We value not only your qualifications but also the opportunity to understand what drives you as a person.  



  

If you would like to know more about the position, do not hesitate to reach out to MMC recruiting ( MMC\_recruiting@maersk.com )


Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.  



We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com .
